title: Scoped instructions need a shared pre-edit and compaction lifecycle for flat and nested tools
wanted_capability: Deliver applicable scoped AGENTS documents before first mutation, consistently for flat tools and code-mode calls, and restore dynamically delivered instructions after mid-turn compaction without relying on the summary.
missing_primitive: Shared instruction-delivery lifecycle at the tool dispatch seam
fallback_used: Read scoped AGENTS documents explicitly before editing. Current patch restores startup context after compaction but does not claim to restore dynamic riders.
notes: Broader model-facing tools audit compared Codex core/src/tools/code_mode/mod.rs shared ToolCallRuntime and compaction context reinjection. Existing first-touch flat rider arrives after operation and nested calls do not deliver it. A fix must preserve full instruction bodies and durable delivery receipts, not hide docs in truncated ordinary tool output. See design/bro-harness/model-facing-tools-audit.md.
